source: Alpaca MCP Server README and the Alpaca connectors' tool schemas, read 2026-11-14

close_position.message: close_position with a percentage, an asset id or no qty cannot be matched to a check. Ask the owner which quantity of one symbol to close.

close_all_positions.message: No single check covers closing every holding. Ask the owner which holdings they want closed.

replace_order_by_id.message: A new quantity is a new order. Ask the owner whether to cancel this order and place a new one.

exercise_options_position.message: Exercising turns a contract into shares. No check covers it.

do_not_exercise_options_position.message: This instruction lets a contract expire. No check covers it.

update_account_config.message: This changes account settings such as shorting or margin. No check covers it.

unknownPlace: A place_ tool this preset has no rule for. No check can be matched to it.
